To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $120,$ and the percentage is $45%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
45%=45÷100=0.45
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =45%\times 120 \\  & =0.45\times 120 \\  & =54\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $45%$ of $120$ is $54.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
45%=\frac{45}{100}=\frac{45÷5}{100÷5}=\frac{9}{20}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =45%\times 120 \\  & =\frac{9}{20}\times 120 \\  & =9\times \frac{120}{20} \\  & =9\times 6 \\  & =54\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $45%$ of $120$ is $54.$
